meta.title: A new custom strategy is created and auto-selected
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

plan.title: Create and Select Custom Savings Strategy

steps.note: Open a valid event create screen to reach the Savings drawer.
Apply a pricing template so the event configuration and savings controls are available.
Add a line item required to configure savings.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event is in a valid configured state.

args.goal: In the Savings Calculation drawer, create a strategy with a fresh unique name, verify the app shows the new strategy as the current selected strategy in the picker, and stop with that selection visible.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated action for creating a custom savings strategy or asserting its picker selection, so perform and verify this buyer-side flow directly on screen.
Verify the expected creation confirmation toast.
